column1: The model you pick, and nowhere else. No analytics, no account. ::: 只发往你选择的模型，不会发往其他地方。无数据分析，无需账号。
You decide what it may do ::: 由你决定它可以做什么
The next step sets how much it asks first. Some actions are never allowed. ::: 下一步设置它先询问的程度。有些操作永远不被允许。
And choose how much Vader asks before it acts. ::: 并选择 Vader 在行动前询问的程度。
Try a first task ::: 试一个任务
A small one, so you see what it asks and shows. You can skip it. ::: 一个小任务，让你看到它会询问什么、展示什么。你可以跳过。
The key may have a space at the end, or may have been revoked. Paste it again. ::: 密钥末尾可能多了空格，或者已被撤销。请重新粘贴。
No local model found ::: 未找到本地模型
Open Ollama's site ::: 打开 Ollama 网站
Open a project, and choose how much Vader asks ::: 打开项目，并选择 Vader 询问的程度
How much should Vader ask before it acts? ::: Vader 在行动前应当询问到什么程度？

Some rules are locked in every mode: never touching your keys or system files, and always asking before installing anything. You can change all of this in Settings. ::: 有些规则在所有模式下都已锁定：绝不触碰你的密钥或系统文件，安装任何东西之前一定询问。你可以在“设置”中更改其余全部内容。
Bring your theme, keybindings and extensions over. Nothing is changed in the original editor. ::: 迁移你的主题、快捷键和扩展。原来的编辑器不会有任何改动。
Import settings from VS Code or Cursor ::: 从 VS Code 或 Cursor 导入设置
What {0} looks like ::: “{0}”模式的效果
Change a file ::: 修改文件
The change, shown in full ::: 完整展示更改内容
The command, shown in full ::: 完整展示命令
Allow once ::: 允许一次
Reject ::: 拒绝
Blocked: credential file ::: 已阻止：凭据文件
Reading a key or credential file is never allowed, in any mode. ::: 读取密钥或凭据文件在任何模式下都不被允许。
Edits ::: 编辑
Commands ::: 命令
Edits go through, and you review them afterwards. ::: 编辑直接生效，事后由你审查。
Edits go through without asking, and you can still review them afterwards. ::: 编辑无需询问直接生效，事后你仍可审查。
Commands run without asking. A command that is locked still waits for you. ::: 命令无需询问直接运行。被锁定的命令仍会等待你确认。
Pick one, or write your own. You will see the plan, every step, and the changes before anything is kept. ::: 选择一个，或自己写一个。在保留任何内容之前，你会看到计划、每一步和所有更改。
Choose a model first ::: 请先选择模型
No provider has a key yet, so there is no model to ask. ::: 还没有任何提供商填写密钥，因此没有可询问的模型。
Use a local model ::: 使用本地模型
Explain this project ::: 讲解这个项目
Reads it and tells you how it fits together. Changes nothing. ::: 阅读项目并告诉你它是如何组织的。不会改动任何内容。
Read only ::: 只读
Find out why a test fails ::: 找出测试失败的原因
Runs the tests, reads the failure, proposes a fix. ::: 运行测试，读取失败信息，并提出修复方案。
Runs commands ::: 运行命令
Write tests for a file ::: 为文件编写测试
Choose the file; it writes tests and runs them. ::: 选择文件，它会编写测试并运行。
Edits files ::: 编辑文件
Add a rules file for this project ::: 为此项目添加规则文件
Writes AGENTS.md so every later task starts with what matters here. ::: 编写 AGENTS.md，让之后的每个任务都从这里的重点内容开始。
Or describe your own task ::: 或者描述你自己的任务
Skip, open Vader ::: 跳过，打开 Vader
What happens after you send it ::: 发送之后会发生什么
It works, and you can watch ::: 它开始工作，你可以随时观看
Each step shows as a quiet line: what it read, searched, edited, ran. ::: 每一步都以安静的一行显示：它读了什么、搜索了什么、改了什么、运行了什么。
It asks when it needs you ::: 需要你时它会询问
The chat is marked "Needs you" in the list, even when you are in another one. ::: 即使你在另一个对话中，列表里的这个对话也会标记为“需要你”。
You review the changes ::: 由你审查更改
Accept a file, a part of a file, or all of it. Undo goes back to a checkpoint. ::: 可以接受一个文件、文件的一部分或全部。撤销会回到某个检查点。
Search chats, files and commands ::: 搜索对话、文件和命令
No changes to commit ::: 没有可提交的更改

Scored just now from what the sources say today. Found in: {0}. It is computed again whenever it is listed, and again for what is installed. It is a guide to what to read first, not a safety check: Vader still asks before the agent runs anything. ::: 刚刚根据各来源今天的说法完成评分。来源：{0}。每次列出时都会重新计算，已安装的内容也会重新计算。它只是提示先读什么，并不是安全检查：智能体运行任何内容之前 Vader 仍会询问。
Found in {0} ::: 来源：{0}

Hosted by Smithery: nothing is installed here. It asks for your own Smithery key, which is sent only to server.smithery.ai. ::: 由 Smithery 托管：这里不会安装任何内容。它需要你自己的 Smithery 密钥，该密钥只会发送到 server.smithery.ai。
What is written into your mcp.json ::: 写入你的 mcp.json 的内容
Adds the entry to your mcp.json and starts it once to check it works. ::: 把这条记录添加到你的 mcp.json，并启动一次以检查是否能正常工作。
Read it before you switch it on. ::: 开启之前请先阅读。
